en.headline: Taxi driver jailed six weeks over North Point crash
en.dek: A 79-year-old driver admitted dangerous driving causing grievous bodily harm after a February collision on Java Road. He was also banned for two years.
body: A 79-year-old taxi driver has been jailed for six weeks after admitting dangerous driving causing grievous bodily harm, over a collision in North Point in February.

He pleaded guilty at Eastern Magistrates' Courts on Thursday. The court heard he was driving a urban taxi on Java Road near lamp post 34832 on 15 February when the left front of the taxi struck a trolley being pushed by a 74-year-old woman who was standing on the broken line between two lanes. She was taken to hospital.

Chief Magistrate So Wai-tak said the driver had a clear record and had not been speeding or breaking other traffic rules, but should have seen the woman and slowed down. The court was told she has remained in a coma.

So said an immediate jail term was appropriate given the injuries and the effect on the family. The driver was also disqualified from driving for two years and must complete a driving improvement course at his own expense.

zh.headline: 北角的士司機認危駕判囚六星期
zh.dek: 79歲司機承認今年2月在渣華道危險駕駛引致他人身體受嚴重傷害，另被停牌兩年。
body: 一名79歲的士司機承認危險駕駛引致他人身體受嚴重傷害，星期四被判囚六星期。案件涉及今年2月北角一宗交通意外。
他在東區裁判法院認罪。案情指，他於2月15日駕駛市區的士，在渣華道近燈柱34832行駛，左側車頭撞上一名74歲女子所推的手推車。該名女子當時站在分隔兩條行車線的虛線上，其後送院。
總裁判官蘇惠德表示，被告過往紀錄良好，事發時沒有超速或其他違反交通規則的行為，但理應看到傷者並減速。法庭獲悉傷者至今仍然昏迷。
蘇官指，考慮到傷勢及對家人的影響，即時監禁屬恰當刑罰。被告另被停牌兩年，並須自費完成駕駛改進課程。
